text:
Oliver (Sales): Heads-up: Nimbus Therapeutics asking for a special "growth accelerator" discount for Q1 to help fund integration. Asking 30% off list for first 3 months and a 12mo ARR commitment after pilot. Need internal ok and routing for >20% discount.
Elaine (Finance): 30% is above our standard approval matrix. Need commercial justification, expected ARR, and whether this is additive to any other promos. 
Oliver (Sales): Commercial rationale: heavy early engineering effort on their side; they want unit economics aligned for first quarter. If we give 30% for Q1 (invoice credits backdated for Jan-Mar), they commit to 12 months at $480k ARR starting Apr. No other promos stacked.
Ruth (Deals): Quick summary: 1) One-off Q1 discount 30% applied as credit to Q1 invoices 2) 12mo ARR commit at specified rate 3) Non-transferable, non-stackable, non-precedent clause required. Also need SF opp update and revenue recognition note.
Elaine (Finance): We'll need modeled impact and assurance this doesn't breach existing discount caps. Also want clawback language if they churn before 6 months. Can Deals/Legal draft clawback and addendum? GL code? Approver?
Oliver (Sales): GL: 6250 - Strategic Deals Credits. Approver: Elaine (Finance) + Director (Revenue Ops) sign-off. I can update SF opp 0157-NIM.
Diego (Legal): I'll draft a short addendum: limited-term Q1 credit, tied to 12mo commit, explicit clawback if cancellation within first 6 months (pro rata recoup), and non-precedent language. Will send to Nimbus counsel for signature.
Elaine (Finance): Also require that credits are recorded as contra-revenue for accounting and clearly labeled in AR. Send a one-line memo for the approval ticket TKT-6789 with approver names.
Ruth (Deals): Noted. I'll produce a 12-month ARR forecast showing net present value with and without the credit and attach to the ticket.
Oliver (Sales): Posted forecast doc to SF and linked in ticket TKT-6789.
Ruth (Deals): Forecast shows short-term revenue reduction of $36k (Q1 credits) but NPV positive assuming 12mo commit. Uploading snapshot now.
Diego (Legal): Draft sent to Nimbus legal (ref: nimbus-legal-2026-33). cc: oliver@redwood, ruth@redwood.
billing-bot: Policy note: discounts >25% require Finance Director approval and signed addendum. Ticket TKT-6789 created.
Oliver (Sales): Nimbus signed addendum at 15:02, returns link: https://drive.redwood/deals/nimbus/addendum-signed.pdf
Elaine (Finance): Received signed addendum and forecast. Approving one-off Q1 credit (30%) booked to GL 6250 as "strategic onboarding credit - Nimbus". Condition: Director (Revenue Ops) sign-off obtained.
Ruth (Deals): Director sign-off received via email at 15:25. I'll attach to TKT-6789.
Elaine (Finance): Final approval granted. We'll post approval into TKT-6789, notify AR to apply credits to Jan-Mar invoices as contra-revenue, and add clawback schedule to renewal docs.
billing-bot: Credit schedule CRED-2026-451 queued for processing. Amount: $36,000 applied across INV-2026-0101..0103. Status: queued.
Oliver (Sales): Great — thanks all. I'll monitor ARR kick-in and ensure renewal paperwork includes clawback reference.
Elaine (Finance): Closing note: record GL 6250, memo "one-off strategic onboarding credit - Nimbus Q1", flagged as non-precedent. TKT-6789 closed after credits queued.
Oliver (Sales): Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
